CustomField.description: Case #05491582, used for reporting commissions amount paid to Drivers for converted leads. Before June 12 2017 1) Lead Commission Calculation - If opportunity amount <1500 then $25 and If opportunity amount >1501 then $50 2) Service Sell Commission Calculation - 10.5% of opportunity amount total. after June 12 2017 1) Lead Commission Calculation - If opportunity amount <1000 then $25 and amount < 3000 then $50 and amount < 5000 then $100 and amount > 5000 then $200 2) Service Sell Commission Calculation - 10.5% of opportunity amount total.
CustomField.label: Driver Commission Amount
